summary:
Congressional efforts to restrict D.C.'s local authority continue, with advocacy groups documenting recent attacks on the District's governance and responding through various channels, while concerns about National Guard deployment in the capital remain a focal point. A U.S. Senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood.

Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
